violated_contract: Every backend request to a developer-supplied URL must reject non-public destinations and connect only to the exact IP address that passed validation; redirects must never create an unvalidated second destination.
canonical_prevention: Route every developer-supplied HTTP target through utils.http_client.safe_request_target, connect to its pinned URL with the returned Host and TLS SNI metadata on a one-request client that cannot reuse a same-IP connection across original hostnames, and disable automatic redirects unless each hop is independently validated and pinned.
